company.name: Enode
company.shortDescription: Enode is accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system by connecting and optimizing the world’s energy devices.
company.description:
Enode is accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system by connecting and optimizing the world’s energy devices. 

Enode’s APIs enable companies to instantly connect users’ energy devices — including EVs, solar inverters, home batteries and thermostats — to their app. With a few lines of code, Enode saves businesses months of integration and ongoing maintenance, cutting the cost and complexity out of building energy management apps.

productsAndServices.description: A single API that enables integration and control of over 1000 energy devices including EVs, solar inverters, home batteries, thermostats, and more.
productsAndServices.name: Connect API

productsAndServices.description: APIs providing algorithms and endpoints for smart charging, scheduling, and energy device insights to optimize energy consumption and costs.
productsAndServices.name: Optimize APIs

productsAndServices.description: APIs that aggregate and manage flexible loads from connected energy devices to participate in flexibility markets and create Virtual Power Plants (VPPs).
productsAndServices.name: Aggregate APIs

productsAndServices.description: A use case enabled by Enode’s APIs that automatically shifts EV charging to off-peak periods to reduce costs and balance grid demand.
productsAndServices.name: Smart Charging

productsAndServices.description: A service that connects and controls residential energy devices to reduce or shift electricity consumption during peak times to balance the grid.
productsAndServices.name: Demand Response

productsAndServices.description: APIs providing real-time EV data such as state of charge, location, and charging status to support e-mobility applications like route planning and public charging.
productsAndServices.name: E-mobility APIs

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $15,000,000, or 87.21% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,300,014 to $71,747,941, a 21.74x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
